newsitem.title: USA: Family Golf slumps, Q4 misses estimates.
newsitem.headline: Family Golf slumps, Q4 misses estimates.

text.p: Shares of Family Golf Centers Inc slumped over 20 percent in early trading after the company posted earnings per share that came in well below analysts' expectations.
The company, which owns, operates and manages golf properties, said it posted "record revenues and net income" for the fourth quarter and year ended December 31, 1996.

It earned $0.04 a share for the quarter, compared with a net loss of $0.03 a share last year before a charge. But the quarterly results fell shy of Wall Street estimates of $0.09 a share, according to First Call.
The company was not immediately available for further information.
The stock fell 4-3/4 to 23-1/4 in heavy early trading.
